```artifact
## Use-Cases & User Stories

**User Stories:**

**As a Patient:**

* **US-001:** Register and apply for an appointment/consultation request within the designated zone.
* **US-002:** Receive prescriptions from authorized chemists.
* **US-003:** Obtain laboratory services from authorized laboratories.

**As an Authorized Chemist:**

* **US-004:** Deliver medicines to patients within the zone.
* **US-005:** Collect payments from patients.
* **US-006:** Mark prescriptions as completed upon delivery.

**As an Authorized Laboratory:**

* **US-007:** Receive sample requests from patients.
* **US-008:** Provide laboratory results to patients.

**Use-Cases:**

* **UC-001:** Register and apply for an appointment/consultation request.
* **UC-002:** Receive prescriptions.
* **UC-003:** Obtain laboratory services.
* **UC-004:** Deliver medicines.
* **UC-005:** Collect payments.
* **UC-006:** Mark prescriptions as completed.

**Constraints:**

* **CR-001:** There will be no systemic matching done to figure out efficiency of the chemist.
* **CR-002:** There will be 1 authorized laboratory per pincode or 1 laboratory for the entire zone.
```
